name: tab-nav
title: Tab Nav
author: @fma-ds/ds
description:
Navigation between the pages of an area that looks like tabs: a `<nav>` of react-aria links where the current page carries `aria-current="page"`.

Unlike `Tabs` there are no panels — each item is a route — so use it for sub-pages and `Tabs` for in-page views.

- **`variant`**: matches the tab styles — `default` (segmented on `muted`, the current page raised), `line` (underlined) or `primary` (segmented on the primary color, for an area's main sections).
- **Current item**: when `isCurrent` is set or its `href` matches `TabNav`'s `currentHref` (exactly, or with `matchPrefix` also on sub-paths).
- **`TabNavItem`**: takes an icon before its label; **`TabNavSeparator`** divides groups.
- **Overflow**: when items don't fit, the strip scrolls sideways and keeps the current page in view; the side that hides items fades out and shows an arrow that turns a page (pointer only, and not on small screens, where the strip is swiped).
- **Full width**: `listClassName="min-w-full"` spreads the items over the whole width while they fit, as in a card header.

Wrap the app in react-aria's `RouterProvider` for client routing.
